description:

122 World of Tennis Sq, Austin, TX

Map it at https://www.google.com/maps/place/122+World+of+Tennis+Sq,+Austin,+TX



Coldwell Banker

ColdwellBankerHomes.com

Some homes just feel right, and 122 World of Tennis is one of them.

Open, updated, and full of light and views, with hardwood floors running throughout. The kitchen opens seamlessly to the dining and living areas, perfect for how people actually live. Four bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bath, including a primary with a walk-in shower, plus storage to spare.

Outside, take your pick: an upstairs balcony with a grill for weeknight dinners, a downstairs patio made for watching a match or two on the courts out back, and a front porch that’s the spot for catching the sunset.

Lakeway location, close to Hamilton Greenbelt, miles of nature trails, Lakeway Swim Center, Lakeway Marina, shopping and restaurants. Lake Travis ISD, lock and leave, low-maintenance lifestyle with low taxes.
